title: OFWs in Saudi Arabia told to avoid oil, military sites amid attacks

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) has advised overseas Filipino workers (OFWs)in Saudi Arabia to avoid military installations and oil facilities following the attacks in the region. This comes as the DMW confirmed on Thursday evening the death of an OFW due to a falling debris from an intercepted drone reportedly bound for the Shaybah oilfield. “DMW advised OFWs to avoid areas potentially affected by attacks, including military installations and oil facilities,” the agency wrote in a statement.
